name: Web Client Languages
subtitle: Advanced Web Development
summary: Focused on HTML5 semantic markup, modern CSS techniques, and client-side JavaScript for progressive enhancement.

assignments.title: HW1 — Introduction & Tooling
assignments.description: First-week setup and a simple hosted intro page.
assignments.focus: Git, GitHub, and Netlify deployment workflow.

assignments.title: HW2 — Semantic HTML & UCD
assignments.description: Applied user-centered design thinking and built the first version of this portfolio in pure semantic HTML.
assignments.focus: 50+ HTML tags, custom elements, and proper document structure.

assignments.title: HW5 — JavaScript & a Static Site Generator
assignments.description: Rebuilt this site as an Eleventy build with a progressive-enhancement theme picker and a custom element backed by a live API.
assignments.focus: Progressive enhancement, web components, and a build-and-deploy pipeline.

name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
subtitle: Search and Reasoning
summary: Covered foundational AI topics including state-space search, adversarial search, constraint satisfaction, and probabilistic reasoning.

assignments.title: HW1 — State Space Search
assignments.description: Implemented BFS, DFS, and A* search on classic AI puzzle problems.
assignments.focus: Heuristic design and comparing algorithm efficiency.

assignments.title: HW2 — Adversarial Search
assignments.description: Built a minimax agent with alpha-beta pruning for a two-player game.

assignments.title: HW3 — Probabilistic Reasoning
assignments.description: Built a Bayesian network and implemented inference algorithms.

name: Deep Learning
subtitle: Deep Learning
summary: Covered neural network fundamentals, backpropagation, convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and modern deep learning architectures.

assignments.title: HW1 — Neural Network Fundamentals
assignments.description: Implemented a feedforward neural network from scratch, including forward propagation and backpropagation.
assignments.focus: Understanding gradient descent and the mechanics of training.

assignments.title: HW2 — Convolutional Neural Networks
assignments.description: Built and trained a CNN for image classification on a benchmark dataset.
assignments.focus: Architecture design choices and their effect on model performance.

assignments.title: HW3 — Sequence Models
assignments.description: Trained a recurrent neural network on sequential data, exploring vanishing gradients and modern alternatives.
assignments.focus: Handling temporal dependencies and comparing RNN variants.
